title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Recurring Ancillary Services Secured by a Resumption Deposit
content:
**Ancillary billing liaison grid — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The resumption recurring-service allowance is read from the recurring charges (cable television, telephone, oxygen concentrator) on the resident's **Ancillary and Optional Services Billing** account; month windows count entries dated fewer than that many whole calendar months before the day the resumption deposit is worked out.

| Recurring charges on the ancillary account | Allowance |
|---|---|
| Posted within the last three months, and every recurring service among them also charged before those three months and in the latest service month billed (the services having run through the whole period) | The total of those charges divided by three |
| Posted within the last three months, but a service among them did not run through the whole period | The total of all the recurring charges billed for the latest service month — the service month of the recurring charge posted latest, the charge posted first deciding where two share that posting date; every service charged for that month counts |
| None posted within the last three months | One month of every recurring service billed within the last twelve months, at the ancillary price schedule's monthly charge for that service |

**Hypothetical cases, at the published ancillary prices.** Cable television and an oxygen concentrator on an Ancillary Account, Private Pay, both charged every month for more than a year at 42.00 and 185.00: the six charges in the window total 681.00, and the allowance is 227.00. No recurring charge in the last three months, cable television last charged eight months ago: one month at 42.00.
